units.source_text: 伞女停止哭泣，继续说道：“

en.t: The umbrella woman stopped crying and went on speaking: "

units.source_text: 我私下暗恋罗连，奈何他的心无比坚笃，凛然拒绝了我，

en.t: I secretly loved Luo Lian, but his heart was utterly steadfast, and he sternly rejected me,

units.source_text: 我心存怨恨，于是诬陷说我腹中之子乃是罗连的骨头，以此来报复他。

en.t: I harbored resentment, so I falsely accused him by saying that the child in my womb was Luo Lian's, using that to take revenge on him.

units.source_text: 罗连品德高尚，竟然不为自己声辩，也不怨恨我，

en.t: Luo Lian was noble in character, yet he did not defend himself, nor did he resent me,

units.source_text: 我犯了这么打错，今天他还不顾安危，冒着地狱之火，救我儿的性命，

en.t: Even after I committed such a grave wrong, today he still disregarded his own safety, braved the fires of hell, and saved my child's life,

units.source_text: 他的慈悲之心广博，真乃耶稣再生啊。

en.t: His merciful heart is boundless; truly, he is Jesus born again.

units.source_text: 我犯了如此大罪，即使是肌肉寸裂于魔爪而死，也心甘情愿。”

en.t: I have committed such a terrible sin that even if my flesh were torn to shreds by demon claws and I died, I would accept it willingly."

units.source_text: 伞女忏悔完毕，有伏在地上痛哭不止。

en.t: When the umbrella woman finished her confession, she again fell to the ground and kept sobbing bitterly.
